maps.name: Barnyard Brawl
maps.desc: A red barn with a hayloft, two chicken coops and a lot of hay to hide behind.

maps.name: Countertop
maps.desc: Egg-sized warfare on a giant kitchen counter: sink canyon, spoon bridge, pancake tower.

maps.name: The Hatchery
maps.desc: An industrial egg plant: incubator rooms, conveyor lanes, a catwalk ring and the central pit.

maps.name: Sunrise Diner
maps.desc: A roadside diner at dawn: booth fights inside, roof duels under the neon sign, cars and trailers outside.

maps.name: Rose Gorge
maps.desc: Wind through rose sandstone and a dry watercourse, then fight across the ledges above the canyon.

maps.name: Cloud Terrace
maps.desc: Climb a misty ridge by staggered stairways or flank through the lower terrace fields.

maps.name: Reservoir Grove
maps.desc: Cross a forested hydraulic work by shallow basin, raised bridge, or the outer embankments.

maps.name: Tuff Labyrinth
maps.desc: Duck around eroded rock screens and short covered passages beneath pale volcanic pinnacles.

maps.name: Boulder Bazaar
maps.desc: A pillared trading street sits among granite boulders, with open riverbed flanks on both sides.

maps.name: Granite Ring
maps.desc: A sunlit dry-stone court: enter through the broken ring or circle its outer paths.

maps.name: Mesa Alcove
maps.desc: A sandstone ridge, sheltered shelves and two canyon bypasses beneath a wide desert sky.

maps.name: Ash Quarter
maps.desc: Roofless courtyards and charcoal streets lead to a columned square.

maps.name: Riverbend Plain
maps.desc: Warm brick terraces and shady paths border a pale, winding river.

maps.name: Basalt Channels
maps.desc: Basalt islets and narrow causeways cross reflective, ankle-deep channels.

maps.name: Highland Caravan
maps.desc: A highland trade road winds between red-earth terraces, canvas stalls, and a climbable stone pass.

maps.name: Atlantic Outpost
maps.desc: Turf-covered halls, timber sheds, and a windy coastal landing create three paths around a longhouse.

maps.name: Forest Causeway
maps.desc: A raised red-stone road cuts through rainforest, with open canopy trails on both sides.

maps.name: Monolith Gardens
maps.desc: A climbable rock garden rises above mirrored water rills, terraces, and flowering courtyards.

maps.name: Volcanic Coast
maps.desc: A basalt terrace between a sea shelf and an inland quarry, with black-stone columns for cover.

maps.name: Coral Port
maps.desc: A coral-stone trade port has a roof route above its storehouse, markets to one side, and quays to the other.

maps.name: Pine Camp
maps.desc: Three trails wind around a pine campground and converge at a climbable fire lookout.

maps.name: Lakeside Cabins
maps.desc: Circle a lake by cabin yards, shoreline shallows, or a raised pier and island crossing.

maps.name: Marsh Boardwalk
maps.desc: Fight across a lattice of raised wooden paths, shallow marsh, and a central observation deck.

maps.name: Canyon Camp
maps.desc: A winding dry wash links sheltered canyon camps below two climbable rim shelves.

maps.name: Island Crossings
maps.desc: Choose a bridge, a string of sandy islets, or the shallow lagoon between two camp shores.

maps.name: Frozen Creek
maps.desc: Cross a frozen creek by three footbridges or its level ice, then circle snowy shelters.

maps.name: Redwood Trails
maps.desc: Wind around giant trunks, fallen logs and a dry creek to contest a climbable central stump.

maps.name: Ridge Watch
maps.desc: Twin stone overlooks command a long saddle, while the lower trails cross beneath their sightlines.

maps.name: Quarry Lookout
maps.desc: Working terraces overlook a broad cut; stone stacks and haul lanes offer routes through the open floor.

maps.name: Desert Airfield
maps.desc: A long exposed runway links two blast shelters; hangars and a raised control deck flank the strip.

maps.name: Beacon Cliffs
maps.desc: Two exposed signal cliffs face across a salt-worn crossing, with lower coastal trails beneath them.

maps.name: Glacier Pass
maps.desc: A raised ice traverse overlooks a sheltered underpass; broken blue ridges split the snowy side routes.

maps.name: Windfarm Heights
maps.desc: Service platforms and turbine foundations punctuate an open highland of long diagonal firing lanes.

maps.name: Dry Reservoir
maps.desc: A drained basin surrounds a three-gate spillway; raised service banks give long views across the silt.

maps.name: Hedge Maze
maps.desc: Looping garden passages circle a pale pavilion and two raised lookout terraces.

maps.name: Cargo Grid
maps.desc: Staggered freight stacks and a central crane bridge split a wide loading yard into looping lanes.

maps.name: Drainworks
maps.desc: Water channels, pump galleries and a walkable central weir make three crossings through an open utility plant.

maps.name: Rooftop Block
maps.desc: Raised plant-room roofs, service cores and open sky alleys above a compact night-time block.

maps.name: Corn Maze
maps.desc: Harvested cross paths loop between tall corn rows, paired timber decks and an orange wind marker.

maps.name: Neon Lanes
maps.desc: A night market of luminous alleys, staggered kiosks and a high central skybridge.
